text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a review article as indicated in the title and text. It discusses how land-use modeling tools inform bioenergy policy decisions, evaluates various land-use change scenarios including indirect land-use change (iLUC), and reviews relevant data and modeling approaches. Although it does not present new spatial future LULC predictions itself, it focuses substantially on the implications of LUC and modeling thereof for bioenergy, thus touching on LULC future prediction. Therefore, it fits the ‘REVIEW’ category as it synthesizes existing LULC prediction research.)
